sections.text:
Disconnect CO2 
cylinders in the GT unit by removing two bolts on the lever.

Disconnect the socket of line cable to avoid 
 discharging of 
 CO2 cylinders

Test the function on 
automatic fire detectors for:
 - Ionization smoke detector IMX 1001 E
 - Heat detector WMX1000 D 90
 - Flame detector FMX

Test Line Rack (Line Card) 
as follows:
 - Adjust line voltage to 12 - 13 DC volts by poti. L-U
 - Adjust break threshold to (1.5 - 2.5) volts by poti. ST
 - Adjust fire threshold to (1.5 - 2.5) volts by 
poti. F
 - Line current reading should by in the range of 12-42 
mA(at - b1)

Test Battery Rack (Battery 
Card)
 - Adjust battery charging tension 26.5 - 27.5 volts by 
potentiometer R26 (R9)
 - Adjust battery charging tension to 3 amps (Max) by 
poti. R30 (R3)

Central Rack
 - Net and switching card adjust voltage out M1 M2 to 23 
- 24 volts by poti R4
 - Main fire control card
 - Adjust impulse time to 1-5 sec by poti. R5

Check fire threshold by 
operating end of the line detector or fire switch
Check break threshold by removing end of the line detector or fire switch

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block
This 
Fire fighting system is working at turbine hall with CO2 using 
smoke, heat and flame detectors.
The 
first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Ali Ali, tested by eng. Al shahat Ahmed 
Moussa, revised by EDEPC. quality control eng. Abdel menim Al Emam, 
accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Melegy Head sector of 
El-Shabab GT power station .
This document is certified by eng. Samir 
 Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman;
 EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
The 
Testing Scheme Consists of:
Early 
warning system FMZ 2001.
Fire 
alarm system.
Fire 
detection control panel FMZ.
Automatic fire detectors.
Early 
warning system FMZ 2001.
Fire 
alarm system.
Fire 
detection control panel FMZ.
Automatic fire detectors.
Safety Precautions
A work pemit must by issued and the qualified maintenance 
 stuff should carry the suitable safety category.
Wear your safety andhealth equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes 
 ... etc.
Disconnect the two pins of CO2 
 cylinders
Disconnect the socket of line cable to avoid 
 discharging of 
 CO2 cylinders
Unit should be out of service
